halo_of_cheese: The new rifleman is Anselm Cheese, once a medical student from Oakmere. The corporal asked if a medical student was any use in a trench. Anselm Cheese said he would find out.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F20. Anselm Cheese was the only one they could still help, and only just. Anselm Cheese was killed outright by a direct hit at S-F20. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.
The papers connected Norbert Cheese to Anselm Cheese. The men took longer to learn Norbert Cheese's own habits, but they made the effort.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F20 and grazed Norbert Cheese's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp of the Concord (@vitocarcioppolo).
killerdogman2010: In Tannenfeld, Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman was a shepherd. In S-F15, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a shepherd again.
The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman and Bastian "Saint" Rocco sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
souptime13: Day 3: Quentin Souptime reached R-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Quentin Souptime saw Jakub You freeze up on the fire step at Saint-Ash crossroads. Quentin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Quentin Souptime was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Quentin Souptime (Hegemony) and Ivo Boi (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Drowned Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
souza.fts.085: Edmund Fts came up the line in the rain with a bullet that missed him and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Edmund Fts answered the first call, number 76 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Edmund Fts saved half a biscuit for later. Later turned out to be six minutes away.
Albin Zgz and Edmund Fts divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Edmund Fts folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

During a lull at Saint-Ash crossroads, Dorian Austintress called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Fts answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
The cook borrowed Edmund Fts's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Edmund Fts pulled Albin Zgz out of a flooded shell hole at Calvary Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
tf.is.zaza: Yann "Brick" Zaza told the sergeant he was a ferryman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Yann "Brick" Zaza saw Gideon "Ghost" Marks freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Brick said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
